Messages.Author: Clinton Richard Wolf
Messages.Body:
First off, let's state once again my opinion that the Muddled Vampire
  Hunter is an awesome card (possibly the Jyhad equivalent of a Prodigal
  Sorceror)... also, he makes cards like Cryptic Mission well worth sticking
  in your deck in case someone else plays him :)

      But a question on just how awesome this man is... the card says
  "Hunter always strikes with first strike..." Does this only apply to
  his 4 hand damage smash, or could you say, equip him with a stake and
  use that as the strike, and if so would it do 1 or 5 damage?

      I'd think 1 since it would be in lieu of the normal pound - but just
  put a lucky blow or two in the deck and you'd have one instantly paralyzed
  vampire. And to have a flamethrower with First strike... brr...

Messages.Author: Tom Wylie
Messages.Body:
Clinton Richard Wolf <wolf@oxy.edu> wrote:
>      But a question on just how awesome this man is... the card says
>  "Hunter always strikes with first strike..." Does this only apply to
>  his 4 hand damage smash, or could you say, equip him with a stake and
>  use that as the strike, and if so would it do 1 or 5 damage?

If you equip him with a weapon, then he uses that weapon at first strike.
His 4 damage can only be used with a weapon if that weapon adds onto
a minion's normal hand damage, which Stake does not...  it's a flat 1 damage.
